rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-6 SIX-BOX (CODE-EVOLVING, FLAT-capacity play): PREV best=iter-4 (cnn reg 2798p, single-scale 3-layer 12ch, K=5 tied prox+DC, scalar alpha, NO momentum, cosine LR + 16 epochs) hr 0.2378 ssim 0.886 psnr 36.44 (~20min, clear of LD-FBP floor 34.08). FAILURE MODE: hr 0.2378 still far below ITNet v1 (0.4398); at 2798p the single-scale 3-layer CNNReg has eff RF only ~7px, too small for Mayos correlated streak/low-dose noise (~15-20px). VERIFIED FINDINGS (respected): (b) the MULTI-SCALE/POOLING reg (micro-UNet) is ARCHITECTURALLY BAD here - iter-2 (8ep) AND iter-5 (16ep, the clean control under iter-4 trainer) BOTH cap at psnr ~32.4 (hr 0), far below the single-scale CNNs 36.4; pooling/downsampling HURTS this tied-prox-DC scheme. So the lever is FLAT (single-scale, NO pooling) capacity + larger RF. CHANGE (CODE, ONE genuine change - the regulariser module): REWROTE CNNReg into a FLAT DILATED residual CNN. Keep reg_type cnn but GROW it: cnn_channels 12->32, cnn_layers 3->5, add per-layer DILATION ladder cnn_dilations=[1,2,4,2,1] (reflect-padded per dilation so spatial size preserved) -> eff RF expands ~7px->~21px at FULL resolution with ZERO downsampling. 37601 reg params (37602 total incl 1 scalar alpha), verified locally: size-preserving on 321px, reg(x)=0 at init (zero-init 1x1 head), iter-4 baseline reproduces 2797 exactly. ~6x SMALLER than ITNet 233k, within ~10-80k target. EVERYTHING ELSE iter-4 byte-for-byte: K=5 single scalar alpha NO momentum NO per-step-alpha plain prox step cosine LR 5e-3->1e-5 16 epochs max_train_s=1080 train_n=200. HYPOTHESIS: flat dilated capacity supplies the long-range context where POOLED capacity FAILED (iter-2/iter-5 capped psnr 32.4); staying full-resolution never blurs/aliases the recon the way pool->upsample does, so it should lift hr ABOVE iter-4 0.2378 toward 0.44 - the exact failure mode iter-5 could not. CLEAN A/B vs iter-5: same trainer, similar ~26-38k capacity, ONLY difference flat-dilated (no pooling) vs multi-scale (pooling). WHY STABLE (not iter-3): recon DYNAMICS unchanged (same K=5, single scalar alpha, plain prox step, cosine LR only DECREASES step from known-stable iter-4 lr); only the reg internal width/depth/dilation grows; zero-init head keeps reg(x)~0 at init so seed = iter-4 GD+DC. BUDGET: dilated convs same FLOP as dense; per-step cost DOMINATED by unchanged DC term (fwd+back project); extra conv width/depth small fraction; max_train_s=1080 hard backstop. PREDICTED hr ~0.28-0.34., reg_type=cnn, n_iter=5, learnable_alpha=True, per_step_alpha=False, momentum=False, cnn_channels=32, cnn_layers=5, alpha_init=0.1, clip_max=0.05, epochs=16, cosine_lr=True, cosine_lr_min=1e-05, lr=0.005, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, cnn_dilations=[1, 2, 4, 2, 1]
